title: Lusona Sand Drawings
tagline: One unbroken line round every dot.
description: A calm line puzzle inspired by the sand drawings of the Chokwe peoples of Angola, DR Congo and Zambia. Turn mirror tiles until the sand line closes into a single loop round every dot. Thirty levels, a daily drawing, hints that explain and Watch and Learn.
howToPlay: Tap a tile to flip its mirror between the two diagonals.
The sand line bends round tile corners; each separate loop has its own colour.
Turn tiles until only one loop is left and it holds every dot.
Stone tiles are fixed. Fewer moves earn more stars.
Tap Think for a hint, or Watch and Learn to see a level solved.
